title: Bank of America is reported to be planning a $250B AI and energy-infrastructure initiative
summary: The Wall Street Journal reported that Bank of America plans to support $250 billion of U.S. infrastructure activity from early 2026 through mid-2027 across lending, investment, capital-markets, banking and advisory work. The stated scope includes data centers, semiconductors, equipment, generation and energy storage; no project allocation, financing agreement or data-center capacity is disclosed.
